name: Yueqiu Zhuiluo Shi
source:
On the ruins of the city, in the ruins of the church.

I started my apocalyptic journey with the silver-haired girl Xun.

Stumbling, full of moving and surprising.

Towards an uncertain future.

Together with her, she left behind a journey of the end of the world that can never be forgotten.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1092400/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
城市废墟上，教堂废墟中。

我和银发少女薰一起开始了我的末日之旅。

跌跌撞撞，充满感动和惊喜。

走向不确定的未来。

她与她一起，留下了一段永生难忘的末日之旅。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1092400/]Steam[/url]]
